Annexure - |

Record Note of the meeting on “Audit of disposal of Pension on Higher
Wages (PoHW) applications” held on 20.06.2025

A Video Conference (VC) was held under the chairmanship of CPFC with the Zonal
ACC/ACC(HQs) commencing at 04:00 PM on 20.06.2025 (Friday) regarding Audit on
Pension on Higher Wages (POHW) :

The following Officers attended the meeting from Head Office.
Shri Ramesh Krishnamurthi, CPFC
. Shri Chandramauli Chakraborty, ACC(HQ) Pension
. Shri Abhay Ranjan, ACC (Audit)
. Shri Soumya Kanti Gupta,RPFC-I (Pension)
Shri Amitabh Prakash, RPFC-I (Audit)
. Shri Amul Raj Singh, RPFC-I (Audit)
Shri Hemant Madhukar Tirpude, RPFC-I (Audit)
hri Muhammed Majaz, RPFC-II (Audit)
hri Shubham Agrawal, RPFC-II (Pension)
O.Shri Keshar Singh, RPFC-II (Audit)

<2)

POMANDUFPWNE
wn

1. Atthe outset, ACC(HQ) Pension informed that Audit of disposal of the POHW
plications is to be initiated as desired by the MoLE and also considered by the
Pension & EDLI Implementation Committee (PEIC). He shared that it has been
decided to have such cases audited by the Internal Audit Parties through a special
* exercise in.a time-bound manner before 30 September 2025.

2. CPEC emphasized that this work should be accorded the highest priority. In order to
get the task completed on priority, he suggested that:
The disposal of PoHW applications pertaining to the Exempted Establishments may be
audited at an early stage as the disposal of such cases would have been predominantly
based on the applicable Trust Rules and similarly the cases of Validation of Options
can also be audited initially. This strategy would allow a significant portion of the
overall Audit workload to be efficiently addressed on priority.
In view of the shortage of human resources in existing IAPs, the concerned Zonal
Offices having jurisdiction over the Internal Audit Parties (IAPs) may provide the field
office staff (AO/EO & SS/Sr.SSA) to assist the TAPs for completing this special
exercise within time.
ZOs may suitably modify the TAP calendars and daily supervise & monitor the
working of the IAPs to accord topmost priority to this task and ensure timely
completion of this special exercise by 30th September 2025.
While auditing the allowed cases, among other aspects, the following points may also
be verified: Pe

) Delay in the issuance of Demand letters, if applic able.

> Delay & correctness in the issuance of PPOs.

) Disbursement of Arrears and Pension.

3. With respect to the disposal of pending PoHW applications, CPFC instructed that -
+ ZOs should closely monitor and ensure that all pending PoHW applications shall be

lamer

disposed of by 30'" June 2025.

In allowed cases, ZOs should ensure that the work related to issuance of Demand
Letters, issuance of PPOs and Disbursement of Arrears and Pension must be
completed at the earliest on priority.

. Thereafter, a presentation (PPT) was given by the RPFC ~ 1 (Audit) on the Audit of

disposal of PoHW applications and the following points were highlighted:

. Objective is to verify whether the PoHW applications were disposed of in accordance

with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court dated 4 Nov. 2022, relevant Rule
provisions, and various HO instructions.

. ZO should prioritize the Office wise/Establishment wise workload.
_ ZO should Plan the Audit by IAPs and may revise the Audit Calendar as required.
. ZO may provide the Field staff (AO/EO & SS/Sr.SSA — preferably 02 AO/EOs and 2

SS/Sr.SSA) to assist the LAP teams for timely conduct of the said audit exercise.

. Priority to be accorded to the audit of applications from the Exempted Establishments

where no. of applications is higher and the disposal is primarily based upon the extant
Trust Rules.
Similarly, the cases of Validation of Options can also be audited initially.

. Daily and Weekly reports of cases audited are to be submitted by IAPs to the ZOs and

the ZOs will check, compile and send to Audit Division, HO on a Google Sheet/ NIC
Collab sheet.

_ ZOs to daily supervise & monitor the working of the IAPs to accord topmost priority

to this task and ensure timely completion of the special exercise by 30th September
2025,

. RPFC-I, RO, Jabalpur shared that for cases pertaining to Branch Units of Exempted

Establishments covered u/s 2A of the Act, the decision should have to be on the basis
of the Trust Rules of the main Establishment covered u/s 1(3)(a)/1(3)(b) of the Act.
ACC(HQ) Pension responded that clarification in this regard has already been issued
to the field offices by the Pension Division.

. ACC, Zonal Office, UP requested that a checklist and one-day training may be given

to the audit team for standardizing the procedure. ACC(HQ) Pension responded that
they will be undertaking briefing of the audit teams in due course. CPFC asked
Pension and Audit Divisions to prepare the check points. ACC, Audit, Head Office
highlighted that in the meantime in order to expedite, all ZOs should get conducted the
audit of the disposal of the PoHW applications from the Exempted establishments
disposed on the basis of the applicable Trust Rules and also the PoHW cases of
validation of Options i.e. Pre 01.09.2014 cases, immediately on priority.

_ ACC, Zonal Office, Gujarat said that the ongoing Internal Audit may be kept in

abeyance, in order to ensure the timely completion of this exercise. ACC, Audit, Head
Office responded that ongoing IAP work should continue along with this special audit
exercise. CPFC emphasized that the audit of disposal*of PoHW applications be
accorded the utmost priority while ensuring the ongoing conduct of IAP work.

_ RPFC-I, RO, Patancheru raised the issue of many ROs not replying to the POHW case

related communications from RO Patancheru citing it as a major reason for the
pending cases. He stated that using e-office instead of e-mail will expedite the process
of disposal and aid in tracking of applications and retrieval of information, CPFC
directed that all pending references among Regional Offices regarding PoHW matters
